throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8' --asm 'st.h $r4, $r20, 0; st.h $r5, $r20, 8; st.h $r6, $r20, 16; st.h $r7, $r20, 24; st.h $r8, $r20, 32; st.h $r9, $r20, 40; st.h $r10, $r20, 48; st.h $r11, $r20, 56'
throughput.notes: 8 independent memory operations take 4.00 cycles. Buffer is at $sp-1024.

notes: Throughput measured with a 1KB stack buffer. Latency not measured; memory latency depends on cache state.
